```{r}
python_bin <- Sys.which(
  "python3"
)
if (python_bin == "") {
  stop(
    paste(
      "python3 was not found.",
      "Install Python 3 before continuing."
    )
  )
}
cat(
  "Using Python:",
  python_bin,
  "\n"
)
# Helper for running Python
run_python_command <- function(args) {
  out <- system2(
    python_bin,
    args = args,
    stdout = TRUE,
    stderr = TRUE
  )
  status <- attr(
    out,
    "status"
  )
  if (is.null(status)) {
    status <- 0L
  }
  return(
    list(
      output = out,
      status = status
    )
  )
}
# Check whether Python CPLEX is installed
check_cplex <- run_python_command(
  c(
    "-c",
    shQuote(
      "import cplex; print(cplex.__version__)"
    )
  )
)
# Install if required

  cat(
    "Python CPLEX package not found.\n"
```

```{r}
CPLEX_SOLVER_SCRIPT <- file.path(
  tempdir(),
  "solve_cplex.py"
)
python_solver <- c(
  "import sys",
  "import cplex",
  "",
  "lpfile = sys.argv[1]",
  "solfile = sys.argv[2]",
  "",
  "problem = cplex.Cplex(lpfile)",
  "",
  "# Suppress CPLEX output",
  "problem.set_log_stream(None)",
  "problem.set_warning_stream(None)",
  "problem.set_results_stream(None)",
  "",
  "# Single thread for reproducible runtime comparison",
  "problem.parameters.threads.set(1)",
  "",
  "# Tight relative optimality tolerance",
  "problem.parameters.mip.tolerances.mipgap.set(1e-6)",
  "",
  "problem.solve()",
  "",
  "status = problem.solution.get_status_string()",
  "print('CPLEX status:', status)",
  "",
  "if not problem.solution.is_primal_feasible():",
  "    print('No primal feasible solution found.')",
  "    sys.exit(2)",
  "",
  "objective = problem.solution.get_objective_value()",
  "print('Objective:', objective)",
  "",
  "try:",
  "    gap = problem.solution.MIP.get_mip_relative_gap()",
  "    print('MIP gap:', gap)",
  "except:",
  "    pass",
  "",
  "problem.solution.write(solfile)"
)
writeLines(
  python_solver,
  CPLEX_SOLVER_SCRIPT
)
cat(
  "Created CPLEX solver at:\n",

  "\n"
```

```{r}
# Section 4: Exact fixed-size best subset selection using CPLEX

best_subset_cplex <- function(
    X,
    y,
    s,
    M = 20
) {
  n <- nrow(X)
  p <- ncol(X)
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Temporary working directory
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  work <- tempfile(
    "cplex_"
  )
  dir.create(
    work
  )
  on.exit(
    unlink(
      work,
      recursive = TRUE
    ),
    add = TRUE
  )
  lpfile <- file.path(
    work,
    "model.lp"
  )
  solfile <- file.path(
    work,
    "solution.sol"
  )
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Write MIQP
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  con <- file(
    lpfile,
    "wt"
  )
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Objective
  ##
  ## min sum r_i^2
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  writeLines(
    "Minimize",
    con
  )
  writeLines(
    " obj: [",
    con
  )
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " + 2 r_%d ^ 2",
        i
      ),
      con
    )
  }
  writeLines(
    " ] / 2",
    con
  )
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Residual constraints
  ##
  ## X beta + r = y
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  writeLines(
    "Subject To",
    con
  )
  chunk <- 10
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    starts <- seq(
      1,
      p,
      by = chunk
    )
    for (cc in seq_along(starts)) {
      start <- starts[
        cc
      ]
      finish <- min(
        start + chunk - 1,
        p
      )
      txt <- ""
      if (cc == 1) {
        txt <- sprintf(
          " resid_%d:",
          i
        )
      }
      for (j in start:finish) {
        a <- X[
          i,
          j
        ]
        if (abs(a) < 1e-14) {
          next
        }
        if (a >= 0) {
          txt <- paste0(
            txt,
            sprintf(
              " + %.12g beta_%d",
              a,
              j
            )
          )
        } else {
          txt <- paste0(
            txt,
            sprintf(
              " - %.12g beta_%d",
              -a,
              j
            )
          )
        }
      }
      if (finish == p) {
        txt <- paste0(
          txt,
          sprintf(
            " + r_%d = %.12g",
            i,
            y[i]
          )
        )
      }
      writeLines(
        txt,
        con
      )
    }
  }
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Big-M constraints
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  for (j in seq_len(p)) {
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " U%d: beta_%d - %.12g z_%d <= 0",
        j,
        j,
        M,
        j
      ),
      con
    )
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " L%d: - beta_%d - %.12g z_%d <= 0",
        j,
        j,
        M,
        j
      ),
      con
    )
  }
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Exactly s predictors
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  writeLines(
    " card:",
    con
  )
  chunk_z <- 25
  for (
    start in seq(
      1,
      p,
      by = chunk_z
    )
  ) {
    finish <- min(
      start + chunk_z - 1,
      p
    )
    txt <- ""
    for (j in start:finish) {
      txt <- paste0(
        txt,
        sprintf(
          " + z_%d",
          j
        )
      )
    }
    if (finish == p) {
      txt <- paste0(
        txt,
        sprintf(
          " = %d",
          s
        )
      )
    }
    writeLines(
      txt,
      con
    )
  }
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Bounds
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  writeLines(
    "Bounds",
    con
  )
  for (j in seq_len(p)) {
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " -%.12g <= beta_%d <= %.12g",
        M,
        j,
        M
      ),
      con
    )
  }
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " r_%d free",
        i
      ),
      con
    )
  }
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Binary variables
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  writeLines(
    "Binary",
    con
  )
  for (
    start in seq(
      1,
      p,
      by = 25
    )
  ) {
    finish <- min(
      start + 24,
      p
    )
    txt <- ""
    for (j in start:finish) {
      txt <- paste0(
        txt,
        sprintf(
          " z_%d",
          j
        )
      )
    }
    writeLines(
      txt,
      con
    )
  }
  writeLines(
    "End",
    con
  )
  close(
    con
  )
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Solve
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  solve_start <- proc.time()[3]
  out <- system2(
    python_bin,
    args = c(
      shQuote(
        CPLEX_SOLVER_SCRIPT
      ),
      shQuote(
        lpfile
      ),
      shQuote(
        solfile
      )
    ),
    stdout = TRUE,
    stderr = TRUE
  )
  solve_seconds <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    solve_start
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Check solution
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (!file.exists(
    solfile
  )) {
    cat(
      paste(
        out,
        collapse = "\n"
      ),
      "\n"
    )
    stop(
      "CPLEX did not produce a solution."
    )
  }
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Status
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  status_line <- grep(
    "^CPLEX status:",
    out,
    value = TRUE
  )
  cplex_status <-
    if (
      length(
        status_line
      ) > 0
    ) {
      sub(
        "^CPLEX status:[[:space:]]*",
        "",
        status_line[1]
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## MIP gap
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  gap_line <- grep(
    "^MIP gap:",
    out,
    value = TRUE
  )
  mip_gap <-
    if (
      length(
        gap_line
      ) > 0
    ) {
      as.numeric(
        sub(
          "^MIP gap:[[:space:]]*",
          "",
          gap_line[1]
        )
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Read XML solution
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  sol <- readLines(
    solfile,
    warn = FALSE
  )
  beta <- numeric(
    p
  )
  z <- numeric(
    p
  )
  for (line in sol) {
    if (!grepl(
      "<variable",
      line,
      fixed = TRUE
    )) {
      next
    }
    name_match <- regmatches(
      line,
      regexec(
        'name="([^"]+)"',
        line,
        perl = TRUE
      )
    )[[1]]
    if (
      length(
        name_match
      ) != 2
    ) {
      next
    }
    name <- name_match[
      2
    ]
    value_match <- regmatches(
      line,
      regexec(
        'value="([-+]?(?:[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]*)?|\\.[0-9]+)(?:[eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?)"',
        line,
        perl = TRUE
      )
    )[[1]]
    if (
      length(
        value_match
      ) != 2
    ) {
      next
    }
    value <- as.numeric(
      value_match[
        2
      ]
    )
    if (grepl(
      "^beta_[0-9]+$",
      name
    )) {
      j <- as.integer(
        sub(
          "^beta_",
          "",
          name
        )
      )
      if (
        !is.na(j) &&
          j <= p
      ) {
        beta[
          j
        ] <- value
      }
    }
    if (grepl(
      "^z_[0-9]+$",
      name
    )) {
      j <- as.integer(
        sub(
          "^z_",
          "",
          name
        )
      )
      if (
        !is.na(j) &&
          j <= p
      ) {
        z[
          j
        ] <- value
      }
    }
  }
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Diagnostics
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  rss <- sum(
    (
      y -
        X %*% beta
    )^2
  )
  max_abs_beta <- max(
    abs(beta)
  )
  if (
    max_abs_beta >
      0.95 * M
  ) {
    warning(
      "A CPLEX coefficient is close to Big-M."
    )
  }
  return(
    list(
      selected =
        which(
          z > 0.5
        ),
      beta =
        beta,
      z =
        z,
      rss =
        rss,
      status =
        cplex_status,
      mip_gap =
        mip_gap,
      solve_seconds =
        solve_seconds,
      max_abs_beta =
        max_abs_beta,
      cplex_output =
        out
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
beta_max <- 2
# CPLEX
big_M <- 20
# L0Learn

# l0_max_support is larger than the largest requested s so
# L0Learn has room to continue through the path.
l0_max_support <- 20
# Initial explicit grid
l0_grid_points <- 1200
# Lambda search range based on a pilot automatic path
l0_upper_multiplier <- 2
l0_lower_multiplier <- 0.02

# where the path jumps across s.

# Reproducibility

  "Experiment 1\n"
)

  "n =",

  "p =",
```

```{r}
# Section 6: Generate one Monte Carlo replication Population-SNR version

generate_replication_base <- function(
    rep_id,
    n,
    p,
    rho,
    max_s,
    beta_min,
    beta_max,
    master_seed
) {
  set.seed(
    master_seed +
      rep_id
  )
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Equicorrelated Gaussian predictors
  ##
  ## X_j = sqrt(rho) Z_0 + sqrt(1-rho) Z_j
  ##
  ## Therefore the population covariance matrix is
  ##
  ## Sigma_rho = (1-rho) I_p + rho 11'
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  common_factor <- rnorm(
    n
  )
  Z <- matrix(
    rnorm(
      n * p
    ),
    nrow = n,
    ncol = p
  )
  X_raw <- sqrt(
    rho
  ) *
    matrix(
      common_factor,
      nrow = n,
      ncol = p
    ) +
    sqrt(
      1 - rho
    ) *
    Z
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Population covariance matrix
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  Sigma_rho <-
    (
      1 -
        rho
    ) *
    diag(
      p
    ) +
    rho *
    matrix(
      1,
      nrow = p,
      ncol = p
    )
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Nested true support
  ##
  ## The same ordering is used for all values of s within
  ## a replication.
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  active_order <- sample(
    seq_len(
      p
    ),
    size = max_s,
    replace = FALSE
  )
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Coefficients
  ##
  ## These are also nested across true model sizes.
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  magnitudes <- runif(
    max_s,
    min = beta_min,
    max = beta_max
  )
  signs <- sample(
    c(
      -1,
      1
    ),
    size = max_s,
    replace = TRUE
  )
  beta_values <-
    signs *
    magnitudes
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Common raw standard-normal noise direction
  ##
  ## IMPORTANT:
  ## Do NOT centre or scale epsilon_base.
  ##
  ## This allows the realised noise variance, and therefore
  ## realised SNR, to fluctuate naturally between replications.
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  epsilon_base <- rnorm(
    n
  )
  return(
    list(
      X_raw =
        X_raw,
      Sigma_rho =
        Sigma_rho,
      active_order =
        active_order,
      beta_values =
        beta_values,
      epsilon_base =
        epsilon_base
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 7: Construct dataset at a particular true model size Population-SNR version

make_dataset <- function(
    base,
    s,
    target_snr
) {
  X_raw <- base$X_raw
  p <- ncol(
    X_raw
  )
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## True support
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  true_support <- sort(
    base$active_order[
      seq_len(
        s
      )
    ]
  )
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## True beta
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  beta_true <- numeric(
    p
  )
  beta_true[
    true_support
  ] <- base$beta_values[
    seq_len(
      s
    )
  ]
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Population signal variance
  ##
  ## Var(x' beta*) = beta*' Sigma_rho beta*
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  population_signal_variance <- as.numeric(
    t(
      beta_true
    ) %*%
      base$Sigma_rho %*%
      beta_true
  )
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Noise variance chosen to give the TARGET POPULATION SNR
  ##
  ## target_snr =
  ##
  ## beta*' Sigma_rho beta* / sigma^2
  ##
  ## therefore
  ##
  ## sigma^2 =
  ##
  ## beta*' Sigma_rho beta* / target_snr
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  sigma_sq <-
    population_signal_variance /
    target_snr
  sigma <- sqrt(
    sigma_sq
  )
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Generate signal from the raw Gaussian design
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  signal_raw <- as.vector(
    X_raw %*%
      beta_true
  )
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Generate noise
  ##
  ## The same epsilon_base is used across values of s within
  ## the replication, but sigma changes as required to maintain
  ## the same population SNR.
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  epsilon <-
    sigma *
    base$epsilon_base
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Response on the original scale
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  y_raw <-
    signal_raw +
    epsilon
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Standardise predictors for fitting
  ##
  ## This is done AFTER generating the response.
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  X <- as.matrix(
    scale(
      X_raw,
      center = TRUE,
      scale = TRUE
    )
  )
  colnames(
    X
  ) <- paste0(
    "X",
    seq_len(
      p
    )
  )
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Centre response because all methods are fitted without
  ## an intercept
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  y <- as.numeric(
    y_raw -
    mean(
      y_raw
    )
  )
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Realised sample SNR
  ##
  ## This is only a diagnostic.
  ##
  ## It should be near target_snr on average, but it should
  ## NOT be exactly equal to target_snr.
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  realised_snr <-
    var(
      signal_raw
    ) /
    var(
      epsilon
    )
  return(
    list(
      X =
        X,
      y =
        y,
      beta_true =
        beta_true,
      true_support =
        true_support,
      sigma =
        sigma,
      sigma_sq =
        sigma_sq,
      population_signal_variance =
        population_signal_variance,
      target_snr =
        target_snr,
      realised_snr =
        realised_snr
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 8: Common helper functions

# OLS refit on selected support
ols_refit <- function(
    X,
    y,
    support
) {
  support <- sort(
    unique(
      as.integer(
        support
      )
    )
  )
  p <- ncol(
    X
  )
  if (
    length(
      support
    ) == 0
  ) {
    return(
      list(
        beta =
          numeric(p),
        fitted =
          rep(
            0,
            length(y)
          ),
        rss =
          sum(
            y^2
          )
      )
    )
  }
  Xs <- X[
    ,
    support,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  fit <- lm.fit(
    x = Xs,
    y = y
  )
  beta <- numeric(
    p
  )
  beta[
    support
  ] <- fit$coefficients
  return(
    list(
      beta =
        beta,
      fitted =
        as.vector(
          fit$fitted.values
        ),
      rss =
        sum(
          fit$residuals^2
        )
    )
  )
}
# Support recovery metrics
support_metrics <- function(
    selected,
    truth
) {
  selected <- sort(
    unique(
      as.integer(selected)
    )
  )
  truth <- sort(
    unique(
      as.integer(truth)
    )
  )
  TP <- length(
    intersect(
      selected,
      truth
    )
  )
  FP <- length(
    setdiff(
      selected,
      truth
    )
  )
  FN <- length(
    setdiff(
      truth,
      selected
    )
  )
  precision <-
    if (
      length(
        selected
      ) > 0
    ) {
      TP /
        length(selected)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  recall <-
    TP /
    length(truth)
  union_size <- length(
    union(
      selected,
      truth
    )
  )
  jaccard <-
    if (
      union_size >
        0
    ) {
      TP /
        union_size
    } else {
      1
    }
  exact <- setequal(
    selected,
    truth
  )
  return(
    list(
      exact =
        exact,
      TP =
        TP,
      FP =
        FP,
      FN =
        FN,
      precision =
        precision,
      recall =
        recall,
      jaccard =
        jaccard
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
fit_combss_method <- function(

) {

      fit$subset_list[[
        s

    )
  )
  return(
    list(
      support =
        support,
      runtime =
        runtime,
      exact_size_available =
        length(support) ==
        s
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 11: ABESS wrapper

fit_abess_method <- function(
    X,
    y,
    s
) {
  start_time <- proc.time()[3]
  fit <- abess::abess(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    family = "gaussian",
    tune.path = "sequence",
    support.size = s,
    tune.type = "gic",
    lambda = 0,
    normalize = 0,
    fit.intercept = FALSE,
    early.stop = FALSE,
    warm.start = TRUE,
    num.threads = 1
  )
  model <- abess::extract(
    fit,
    support.size = s
  )
  runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    start_time
  beta_hat <- as.numeric(
    model$beta
  )
  support <- sort(
    which(
      abs(
        beta_hat
      ) >
        1e-10
    )
  )
  return(
    list(
      support =
        support,
      runtime =
        runtime,
      exact_size_available =
        length(support) ==
        s
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 12: Dense L0Learn path

fit_l0learn_dense <- function(
    X,
    y,
    target_s,
    max_support,
    grid_points = 1200,
    upper_multiplier = 2,
    lower_multiplier = 0.02,
    refine_points = 300
) {
  total_start <- proc.time()[3]
  ## ==========================================================
  ## STEP 1
  ## Pilot path to identify appropriate lambda range
  ## ==========================================================
  pilot_fit <- L0Learn::L0Learn.fit(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    loss = "SquaredError",
    penalty = "L0",
    algorithm = "CD",
    maxSuppSize =
      max_support,
    nLambda = 100,
    scaleDownFactor = 0.80,
    intercept = FALSE
  )
  pilot_lambda <- as.numeric(
    pilot_fit$lambda[[1]]
  )
  pilot_lambda <- pilot_lambda[
    is.finite(
      pilot_lambda
    ) &
      pilot_lambda >
      0
  ]
  if (
    length(
      pilot_lambda
    ) < 2
  ) {
    stop(
      "L0Learn pilot path did not produce a usable lambda range."
    )
  }
  lambda_upper <-
    max(
      pilot_lambda
    ) *
    upper_multiplier
  lambda_lower <-
    min(
      pilot_lambda
    ) *
    lower_multiplier
  ## ==========================================================
  ## STEP 2
  ## Dense logarithmic grid
  ## ==========================================================
  lambda_grid <- exp(
    seq(
      from =
        log(
          lambda_upper
        ),
      to =
        log(
          lambda_lower
        ),
      length.out =
        grid_points
    )
  )
  ## ==========================================================
  ## STEP 3
  ## Main CDPSI fit
  ## ==========================================================
  fit <- L0Learn::L0Learn.fit(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    loss = "SquaredError",
    penalty = "L0",
    algorithm = "CDPSI",
    maxSuppSize =
      max_support,
    lambdaGrid =
      list(
        lambda_grid
      ),
    partialSort = TRUE,
    maxIters = 200,
    rtol = 1e-6,
    atol = 1e-9,
    activeSet = TRUE,
    activeSetNum = 3,
    maxSwaps = 100,
    screenSize = ncol(X),
    intercept = FALSE
  )
  support_sizes <- as.integer(
    fit$suppSize[[1]]
  )
  fitted_lambda <- as.numeric(
    fit$lambda[[1]]
  )
  ## ==========================================================
  ## STEP 4
  ## Targeted refinement if target size was skipped
  ## ==========================================================
  target_present <- target_s %in%
    support_sizes
  refined <- FALSE
  if (
    !target_present &&
      length(
        support_sizes
      ) >= 2
  ) {
    crossing_intervals <- integer(
      0
    )
    for (
      i in seq_len(
        length(
          support_sizes
        ) - 1
      )
    ) {
      s1 <- support_sizes[
        i
      ]
      s2 <- support_sizes[
        i + 1
      ]
      ## Does this interval jump over target_s?
      if (
        min(
          s1,
          s2
        ) <
          target_s &&
          max(
            s1,
            s2
          ) >
          target_s
      ) {
        crossing_intervals <- c(
          crossing_intervals,
          i
        )
      }
    }
    ## --------------------------------------------------------
    ## Add very dense lambda points around any jumps over s
    ## --------------------------------------------------------
    if (
      length(
        crossing_intervals
      ) > 0
    ) {
      extra_lambda <- numeric(
        0
      )
      for (
        i in crossing_intervals
      ) {
        lambda_a <- fitted_lambda[
          i
        ]
        lambda_b <- fitted_lambda[
          i + 1
        ]
        upper <- max(
          lambda_a,
          lambda_b
        )
        lower <- min(
          lambda_a,
          lambda_b
        )
        if (
          is.finite(
            upper
          ) &&
            is.finite(
              lower
            ) &&
            lower >
            0 &&
            upper >
            lower
        ) {
          local_grid <- exp(
            seq(
              from =
                log(
                  upper
                ),
              to =
                log(
                  lower
                ),
              length.out =
                refine_points +
                2
            )
          )
          ## Remove endpoints because already present
          local_grid <- local_grid[
            -c(
              1,
              length(
                local_grid
              )
            )
          ]
          extra_lambda <- c(
            extra_lambda,
            local_grid
          )
        }
      }
      if (
        length(
          extra_lambda
        ) > 0
      ) {
        refined <- TRUE
        refined_grid <- sort(
          unique(
            c(
              lambda_grid,
              extra_lambda
            )
          ),
          decreasing = TRUE
        )
        fit <- L0Learn::L0Learn.fit(
          x = X,
          y = y,
          loss = "SquaredError",
          penalty = "L0",
          algorithm = "CDPSI",
          maxSuppSize =
            max_support,
          lambdaGrid =
            list(
              refined_grid
            ),
          partialSort = TRUE,
          maxIters = 200,
          rtol = 1e-6,
          atol = 1e-9,
          activeSet = TRUE,
          activeSetNum = 3,
          maxSwaps = 100,
          screenSize = ncol(X),
          intercept = FALSE
        )
        lambda_grid <-
          refined_grid
        support_sizes <- as.integer(
          fit$suppSize[[1]]
        )
        fitted_lambda <- as.numeric(
          fit$lambda[[1]]
        )
      }
    }
  }
  ## ==========================================================
  ## STEP 5
  ## Extract all distinct model sizes
  ## ==========================================================
  beta_path <- as.matrix(
    fit$beta[[1]]
  )
  available_sizes <- sort(
    unique(
      support_sizes
    )
  )
  available_sizes <- available_sizes[
    available_sizes <=
      max_support
  ]
  ## ==========================================================
  ## STEP 6
  ## Extract requested target size
  ## ==========================================================
  exact_indices <- which(
    support_sizes ==
      target_s
  )
  exact_size_available <- (
    length(
      exact_indices
    ) > 0
  )
  support <- integer(
    0
  )
  selected_lambda <- NA_real_
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## If target size occurs multiple times, choose the support
  ## with smallest OLS-refitted RSS.
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (
    exact_size_available
  ) {
    candidate_rss <- rep(
      NA_real_,
      length(
        exact_indices
      )
    )
    candidate_supports <- vector(
      mode = "list",
      length = length(
        exact_indices
      )
    )
    for (
      ii in seq_along(
        exact_indices
      )
    ) {
      j <- exact_indices[
        ii
      ]
      beta_j <- beta_path[
        ,
        j
      ]
      support_j <- sort(
        which(
          abs(
            beta_j
          ) >
            1e-10
        )
      )
      candidate_supports[[
        ii
      ]] <- support_j
      candidate_rss[
        ii
      ] <- ols_refit(
        X = X,
        y = y,
        support =
          support_j
      )$rss
    }
    best_candidate <- which.min(
      candidate_rss
    )
    best_index <- exact_indices[
      best_candidate
    ]
    support <- candidate_supports[[
      best_candidate
    ]]
    selected_lambda <- fitted_lambda[
      best_index
    ]
  }
  ## ==========================================================
  ## STEP 7
  ## Nearest model-size diagnostic
  ## ==========================================================
  size_distance <- abs(
    available_sizes -
      target_s
  )
  nearest_size <-
    if (
      length(
        available_sizes
      ) > 0
    ) {
      available_sizes[
        which.min(
          size_distance
        )
      ]
    } else {
      NA_integer_
    }
  runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    total_start
  return(
    list(
      support =
        support,
      runtime =
        runtime,
      exact_size_available =
        exact_size_available,
      selected_lambda =
        selected_lambda,
      available_sizes =
        available_sizes,
      number_distinct_sizes =
        length(
          available_sizes
        ),
      nearest_size =
        nearest_size,
      refined =
        refined,
      number_lambda_values =
        length(
          fitted_lambda
        ),
      raw_support_sizes =
        support_sizes,
      fit =
        fit
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 14: Safe fitting wrapper

safe_fit <- function(
    fit_function,
    ...
) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      ans <- fit_function(
        ...
      )
      ans$success <- TRUE
      ans$error <- NA_character_
      return(
        ans
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      return(
        list(
          success =
            FALSE,
          support =
            integer(0),
          runtime =
            NA_real_,
          exact_size_available =
            FALSE,
          error =
            conditionMessage(e)
        )
      )
    }
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 15: Convert one fit into a result row

make_result_row <- function(
    rep_id,
    s,
    method,
    fit,
    data
) {
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Failed fit
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (
    !fit$success
  ) {
    return(
      data.frame(
        rep =
          rep_id,
        s =
          s,
        method =
          method,
        success =
          FALSE,
        exact_size_available =
          FALSE,
        selected_size =
          NA_integer_,
        exact_recovery =
          NA,
        TP =
          NA_integer_,
        FP =
          NA_integer_,
        FN =
          NA_integer_,
        precision =
          NA_real_,
        recall =
          NA_real_,
        jaccard =
          NA_real_,
        rss =
          NA_real_,
        runtime =
          NA_real_,
        target_snr =
          data$target_snr,
        population_signal_variance =
          data$population_signal_variance,
        sigma_sq =
          data$sigma_sq,
        sigma =
          data$sigma,
        realised_snr =
          data$realised_snr,
        support_key =
          NA_character_,
        true_support_key =
          paste(
            data$true_support,
            collapse = ","
          ),
        cplex_status =
          NA_character_,
        cplex_gap =
          NA_real_,
        big_m_ratio =
          NA_real_,
        l0_distinct_sizes =
          NA_integer_,
        l0_available_sizes =
          NA_character_,
        l0_nearest_size =
          NA_integer_,
        l0_refined =
          NA,
        l0_lambda_points =
          NA_integer_,
        error =
          fit$error,
        stringsAsFactors =
          FALSE
      )
    )
  }
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## L0Learn did not produce exact requested size
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (
    !fit$exact_size_available
  ) {
    return(
      data.frame(
        rep =
          rep_id,
        s =
          s,
        method =
          method,
        success =
          TRUE,
        exact_size_available =
          FALSE,
        selected_size =
          NA_integer_,
        exact_recovery =
          NA,
        TP =
          NA_integer_,
        FP =
          NA_integer_,
        FN =
          NA_integer_,
        precision =
          NA_real_,
        recall =
          NA_real_,
        jaccard =
          NA_real_,
        rss =
          NA_real_,
        runtime =
          fit$runtime,
        target_snr =
          data$target_snr,
        population_signal_variance =
          data$population_signal_variance,
        sigma_sq =
          data$sigma_sq,
        sigma =
          data$sigma,
        realised_snr =
          data$realised_snr,
        support_key =
          NA_character_,
        true_support_key =
          paste(
            data$true_support,
            collapse = ","
          ),
        cplex_status =
          NA_character_,
        cplex_gap =
          NA_real_,
        big_m_ratio =
          NA_real_,
        l0_distinct_sizes =
          if (
            !is.null(
              fit$number_distinct_sizes
            )
          ) {
            fit$number_distinct_sizes
          } else {
            NA_integer_
          },
        l0_available_sizes =
          if (
            !is.null(
              fit$available_sizes
            )
          ) {
            paste(
              fit$available_sizes,
              collapse = ","
            )
          } else {
            NA_character_
          },
        l0_nearest_size =
          if (
            !is.null(
              fit$nearest_size
            )
          ) {
            fit$nearest_size
          } else {
            NA_integer_
          },
        l0_refined =
          if (
            !is.null(
              fit$refined
            )
          ) {
            fit$refined
          } else {
            NA
          },
        l0_lambda_points =
          if (
            !is.null(
              fit$number_lambda_values
            )
          ) {
            fit$number_lambda_values
          } else {
            NA_integer_
          },
        error =
          NA_character_,
        stringsAsFactors =
          FALSE
      )
    )
  }
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Valid fixed-size result
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  selected <- sort(
    fit$support
  )
  metrics <- support_metrics(
    selected =
      selected,
    truth =
      data$true_support
  )
  refit <- ols_refit(
    X =
      data$X,
    y =
      data$y,
    support =
      selected
  )
  cplex_status <-
    if (
      !is.null(
        fit$status
      )
    ) {
      fit$status
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
  cplex_gap <-
    if (
      !is.null(
        fit$mip_gap
      )
    ) {
      fit$mip_gap
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  big_m_ratio <-
    if (
      !is.null(
        fit$max_abs_beta
      )
    ) {
      fit$max_abs_beta /
        big_M
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  return(
    data.frame(
      rep =
        rep_id,
      s =
        s,
      method =
        method,
      success =
        TRUE,
      exact_size_available =
        TRUE,
      selected_size =
        length(
          selected
        ),
      exact_recovery =
        metrics$exact,
      TP =
        metrics$TP,
      FP =
        metrics$FP,
      FN =
        metrics$FN,
      precision =
        metrics$precision,
      recall =
        metrics$recall,
      jaccard =
        metrics$jaccard,
      rss =
        refit$rss,
      runtime =
        fit$runtime,
      target_snr =
        data$target_snr,
      population_signal_variance =
        data$population_signal_variance,
      sigma_sq =
        data$sigma_sq,
      sigma =
        data$sigma,
      realised_snr =
        data$realised_snr,
      support_key =
        paste(
          selected,
          collapse = ","
        ),
      true_support_key =
        paste(
          data$true_support,
          collapse = ","
        ),
      cplex_status =
        cplex_status,
      cplex_gap =
        cplex_gap,
      big_m_ratio =
        big_m_ratio,
      l0_distinct_sizes =
        if (
          !is.null(
            fit$number_distinct_sizes
          )
        ) {
          fit$number_distinct_sizes
        } else {
          NA_integer_
        },
      l0_available_sizes =
        if (
          !is.null(
            fit$available_sizes
          )
        ) {
          paste(
            fit$available_sizes,
            collapse = ","
          )
        } else {
          NA_character_
        },
      l0_nearest_size =
        if (
          !is.null(
            fit$nearest_size
          )
        ) {
          fit$nearest_size
        } else {
          NA_integer_
        },
      l0_refined =
        if (
          !is.null(
            fit$refined
          )
        ) {
          fit$refined
        } else {
          NA
        },
      l0_lambda_points =
        if (
          !is.null(
            fit$number_lambda_values
          )
        ) {
          fit$number_lambda_values
        } else {
          NA_integer_
        },
      error =
        NA_character_,
      stringsAsFactors =
        FALSE
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 16: Sanity check

test_base <- generate_replication_base(
  rep_id = 1,
  n = n,
  p = p,
  rho = rho,
  max_s =
    max(
      true_sizes
    ),
  beta_min =
    beta_min,

    beta_max,

    master_seed
)
test_data <- make_dataset(
  base =
    test_base,
  s = 4,
  target_snr =
    target_snr
)
# Data-generating process checks
cat(
  "True support:",
  paste(
    test_data$true_support,
    collapse = ", "
  ),
  "\n\n"
)
cat(
  "Target population SNR:",
  test_data$target_snr,
  "\n"
)

  "Population signal variance:",

    test_data$population_signal_variance,
    6
  ),
  "\n"
)

  "Population noise variance:",

  ),
  "\n"
)

    test_data$sigma,

  ),
  "\n"
)

  "Population SNR check:",

    test_data$population_signal_variance /
      test_data$sigma_sq,

)

  "Realised sample SNR:",

  ),

  s = 4
)
# Print selected supports

  "\nCPLEX support:",

    test_cplex$support,
    collapse = ", "
  ),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "COMBSS support:",
  paste(
    test_combss$support,
    collapse = ", "
  ),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "ABESS support:",
  paste(
    test_abess$support,
    collapse = ", "
  ),
  "\n"
)
if (
  test_l0learn$exact_size_available
) {

    "L0Learn support:",

      test_l0learn$support,

    ),
    "\n"

} else {

    "L0Learn did not produce size 4.\n"
  )

# CPLEX Big-M diagnostic
if (
  !is.null(
    test_cplex$max_abs_beta
  )
) {
  cat(
    "\nMaximum absolute CPLEX coefficient:",
    round(
      test_cplex$max_abs_beta,
      6
    ),
    "\n"
  )
  cat(
    "Big-M:",
    big_M,
    "\n"
  )
  cat(
    "Max coefficient / Big-M:",
    round(
      test_cplex$max_abs_beta /
        big_M,
      6
    ),
    "\n"
  )
}
# L0Learn diagnostics
cat(
  "\nL0Learn available sizes:",
  paste(
    test_l0learn$available_sizes,
    collapse = ", "
  ),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "L0Learn distinct sizes:",
  test_l0learn$number_distinct_sizes,
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "L0Learn targeted refinement used:",
  test_l0learn$refined,
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "L0Learn lambda points:",
  test_l0learn$number_lambda_values,
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# Section 17: Main Experiment 1

dir.create(
  "experiment1_results",
  showWarnings = FALSE
)
results_list <- list()
row_counter <- 1
experiment_start <- Sys.time()
for (
  r in seq_len(
    n_rep
  )
) {
  cat("\n")
  cat(
    "============================================================\n"
  )
  cat(
    "REPLICATION",
    r,
    "OF",
    n_rep,
    "\n"
  )
  cat(
    "============================================================\n"
  )
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Common random structure across all s in this replication
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  base <- generate_replication_base(
    rep_id =
      r,
    n =
      n,
    p =
      p,
    rho =
      rho,
    max_s =
      max(
        true_sizes
      ),
    beta_min =
      beta_min,
    beta_max =
      beta_max,
    master_seed =
      master_seed
  )
  for (
    s in true_sizes
  ) {
    cat(
      "\nTrue model size s =",
      s,
      "\n"
    )
    ## --------------------------------------------------------
    ## Dataset
    ## --------------------------------------------------------
    data <- make_dataset(
      base =
        base,
      s =
        s,
      target_snr =
        target_snr
    )
    ## ========================================================
    ## CPLEX
    ## ========================================================
    cat(
      "  CPLEX...\n"
    )
    fit <- safe_fit(
      fit_cplex_method,
      X =
        data$X,
      y =
        data$y,
      s =
        s,
      M =
        big_M
    )
    results_list[[
      row_counter
    ]] <- make_result_row(
      rep_id =
        r,
      s =
        s,
      method =
        "CPLEX",
      fit =
        fit,
      data =
        data
    )
    row_counter <-
      row_counter +
      1
    ## ========================================================
    ## COMBSS
    ## ========================================================
    cat(
      "  COMBSS...\n"
    )
    fit <- safe_fit(
      fit_combss_method,
      X =
        data$X,
      y =
        data$y,
      s =
        s
    )
    results_list[[
      row_counter
    ]] <- make_result_row(
      rep_id =
        r,
      s =
        s,
      method =
        "COMBSS",
      fit =
        fit,
      data =
        data
    )
    row_counter <-
      row_counter +
      1
    ## ========================================================
    ## ABESS
    ## ========================================================
    cat(
      "  ABESS...\n"
    )
    fit <- safe_fit(
      fit_abess_method,
      X =
        data$X,
      y =
        data$y,
      s =
        s
    )
    results_list[[
      row_counter
    ]] <- make_result_row(
      rep_id =
        r,
      s =
        s,
      method =
        "ABESS",
      fit =
        fit,
      data =
        data
    )
    row_counter <-
      row_counter +
      1
    ## ========================================================
    ## L0Learn
    ## ========================================================
    cat(
      "  L0Learn...\n"
    )
    fit <- safe_fit(
      fit_l0learn_method,
      X =
        data$X,
      y =
        data$y,
      s =
        s
    )
    results_list[[
      row_counter
    ]] <- make_result_row(
      rep_id =
        r,
      s =
        s,
      method =
        "L0Learn",
      fit =
        fit,
      data =
        data
    )
    row_counter <-
      row_counter +
      1
  }
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Checkpoint after every replication
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  checkpoint <- bind_rows(
    results_list
  )
  saveRDS(
    checkpoint,
    file =
      "experiment1_results/experiment1_checkpoint.rds"
  )
  cat(
    "\nReplication",
    r,
    "saved.\n"
  )
}
experiment_end <- Sys.time()
results <- bind_rows(
  results_list
)
cat(
  "\nExperiment completed.\n"
)
cat(
  "Total elapsed time:",
  as.character(
    experiment_end -
      experiment_start
  ),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# Section 21: Compare approximate methods with CPLEX

# Reload clean raw results from the final Section 17 checkpoint
# This prevents repeated execution of Section 21 from creating
# duplicated join columns such as cplex_support_key.x/.y.
checkpoint_file <-
  "experiment1_results/experiment1_checkpoint.rds"
if (
  !file.exists(
    checkpoint_file
  )
) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "Could not find:",
      checkpoint_file
    )
  )
}
results <- readRDS(
  checkpoint_file
)
cat(
  "Reloaded raw Experiment 1 results:",
  nrow(
    results
  ),
  "rows.\n"
)
# Verify that each replication / model-size / method
# combination occurs exactly once.
# Experiment 1 should contain:
# 100 replications x 5 model sizes x 4 methods = 2000 rows
duplicate_check <- results %>%
  dplyr::count(
    rep,
    s,
    method,
    name = "n_rows"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    n_rows !=
      1
  )
if (
  nrow(
    duplicate_check
  ) >
    0
) {
  print(
    duplicate_check
  )
  stop(
    paste(
      "The raw checkpoint contains duplicate",
      "(rep, s, method) combinations."
    )
  )
}
cat(
  "Unique (rep, s, method) check passed.\n"
)
# Construct unique CPLEX reference
# There should be exactly one CPLEX solution for each
# replication and true model size.
cplex_reference <- results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    method ==
      "CPLEX",
    success,
    exact_size_available
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    rep,
    s,
    cplex_support_key =
      support_key,
    cplex_rss =
      rss
  )
# Verify uniqueness of CPLEX reference
cplex_duplicate_check <- cplex_reference %>%
  dplyr::count(
    rep,
    s,
    name = "n_rows"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    n_rows !=
      1
  )
if (
  nrow(
    cplex_duplicate_check
  ) >
    0
) {
  print(
    cplex_duplicate_check
  )
  stop(
    paste(
      "CPLEX reference is not unique",
      "for some (rep, s) combinations."
    )
  )
}
cat(
  "Unique CPLEX reference check passed.\n"
)
# Join each method with the corresponding CPLEX solution
# relationship = 'many-to-one' explicitly states that many
# method rows may correspond to one CPLEX reference row.
results <- results %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    cplex_reference,
    by = c(
      "rep",
      "s"
    ),
    relationship =
      "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    agrees_with_cplex =
      ifelse(
        success &
          exact_size_available &
          !is.na(
            cplex_support_key
          ),
        support_key ==
          cplex_support_key,
        NA
      ),
    relative_rss_gap =
      ifelse(
        success &
          exact_size_available &
          !is.na(
            cplex_rss
          ) &
          cplex_rss >
            0,
        (
          rss -
            cplex_rss
        ) /
          cplex_rss,
        NA_real_
      )
  )
# Final checks
cat(
  "Rows after CPLEX join:",
  nrow(
    results
  ),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Expected rows:",
  n_rep *
    length(
      true_sizes
    ) *
    4,
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "CPLEX reference rows:",
  nrow(
    cplex_reference
  ),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Expected CPLEX reference rows:",
  n_rep *
    length(
      true_sizes
    ),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# Section 23: Summary

mean_safe <- function(x) {
  if (
    length(
      x
    ) ==
      0 ||
      all(
        is.na(
          x
        )
      )
  ) {
    return(
      NA_real_
    )
  }
  mean(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}
median_safe <- function(x) {
  if (
    length(
      x
    ) ==
      0 ||
      all(
        is.na(
          x
        )
      )
  ) {
    return(
      NA_real_
    )
  }
  median(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}
summary_results <- results %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    s,
    method
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    replications =
      dplyr::n(),
    successful_runs =
      sum(
        success
      ),
    exact_size_rate =
      mean(
        exact_size_available
      ),
    exact_recovery_rate =
      mean_safe(
        as.numeric(
          exact_recovery
        )
      ),
    mean_TP =
      mean_safe(
        TP
      ),
    mean_FP =
      mean_safe(
        FP
      ),
    mean_FN =
      mean_safe(
        FN
      ),
    mean_precision =
      mean_safe(
        precision
      ),
    mean_recall =
      mean_safe(
        recall
      ),
    mean_jaccard =
      mean_safe(
        jaccard
      ),
    cplex_agreement_rate =
      mean_safe(
        as.numeric(
          agrees_with_cplex
        )
      ),
    median_relative_rss_gap =
      median_safe(
        relative_rss_gap
      ),
    median_runtime =
      median_safe(
        runtime
      ),
    .groups =
      "drop"
  )
print(
  summary_results
)
```

```{r}
# Section 24: Exact support recovery

recovery_plot_data <- results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    success,
    exact_size_available
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    s,
    method
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    recovery_rate =
      mean(
        exact_recovery
      ),
    n =
      dplyr::n(),
    .groups =
      "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    se =
      sqrt(
        recovery_rate *
          (
            1 -
              recovery_rate
          ) /
          n
      ),
    lower =
      pmax(
        0,
        recovery_rate -
          1.96 *
            se
      ),
    upper =
      pmin(
        1,
        recovery_rate +
          1.96 *
            se
      )
  )
p_recovery <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  recovery_plot_data,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x =
      s,
    y =
      recovery_rate,
    group =
      method,
    linetype =
      method,
    shape =
      method
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
    ggplot2::aes(
      ymin =
        lower,
      ymax =
        upper
    ),
    width = 0.15
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks =
      true_sizes
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(
      0,
      1
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x =
      "True model size",
    y =
      "Exact support recovery rate",
    linetype =
      "Method",
    shape =
      "Method"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
print(
  p_recovery
)
```
